document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Two  days  of  work,  using  improvised  tools  and  methods, 
produces  a  raft  fit  to  dare  the  rough  waters  of  the  lower 
Hanninah. Your party loads its meager possessions and poles 
out into the hazardous channel.

In  the  days  that  follow,  you  struggle  down  canyons  and 
rapids, but the raft holds. Perhaps you become overconfident, 
for in a particularly formidable patch of whitewater, the raft 
bounces on a surge and then plunges bow-first.
